Photograph of the white-border [[Dagobah: Cave (Revised)]] card, published by [[Decipher]]. The complete photograph is available at the linked original image URL. The photographer is not identified in the retained acquisition evidence.

== Source ==
* Physical white-border face: [https://i.ebayimg.com/images/g/bOIAAOSwDyZgs8o4/s-l1600.webp complete card photograph].

== Preparation ==
The complete 1600 × 1200-pixel native photograph is retained separately. Rectangle (0, 0)–(1600, 1200) was extracted with right and bottom coordinates exclusive. The extracted rectangle was rotated 180 degrees counterclockwise. It was downsampled with Pillow Lanczos resampling to 467 × 350 pixels and saved as PNG. Printed words, artwork, icons, legal text and borders were not repainted or reconstructed. This is a photographic reproduction, not a facsimile. Where the source photograph itself meets the canvas boundary, no unseen outer paper was synthesized. The photograph or acquisition date does not establish the card’s first publication date.
